description: A deployment script for UWP that generates an AppxManifest.xml file using templates and configuration parameters.

methods.name: _GenerateAppxManifestContent
methods.description: Generates the content of the AppxManifest.xml by reading application section files, creating version string, and rendering a Jinja2 template.

methods.name: _WriteAppxManifest
methods.description: Writes the generated AppxManifest content to a file with file locking and retry logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and initiates the process to generate the AppxManifest.
